description: List every outcome link in an account or course context — the many-to-many join between outcome groups and the outcomes they contain, read from the context root, not one specific group. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Each link nests its outcome_group and outcome (full detail when outcome_style="full" / outcome_group_style="full", abbreviated otherwise); use list_outcome_group_outcomes instead to list only the outcomes linked directly under one specific outcome_group_id.

context_id.description: The Canvas account ID or course ID for the context.

context_type.description: Whether to read outcome links from an account or course context.

outcome_group_style.description: Outcome group detail level. Use "full" to include expanded outcome group fields.

outcome_style.description: Outcome detail level. Use "full" to include expanded outcome fields.

name: list_outcome_group_links
title: List Outcome Group Links
